title: SeaCausal-FL: Federated Fuzzy Causal Learning for Maritime IoT Fault Diagnosis and Counterfactual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable marine-engine fault diagnosis in maritime IoT is challenged by distributed data ownership, heterogeneous fault distributions, and continuously changing operating conditions. This paper proposes SeaCausal-FL, a federated fuzzy causal learning framework that combines a shared temporal diagnostic path with mechanism-conditioned causal reasoning. An interval type-2 fuzzy layer represents uncertain and overlapping operating mechanisms, while each mechanism is associated with a physics-constrained structural causal model. Before aggregation, locally learned mechanisms are aligned using operating context, causal structure, and conditional intervention-response signatures. Model parameters are then aggregated according to sample, class, mechanism, and mechanism-class evidence instead of client sample size alone. The learned structural equations further support interval counterfactual reasoning through abduction, action, and prediction.

translated_title: SeaCausal-FL：面向海事物联网故障诊断与反事实推理的联邦模糊因果学习
translated_abstract: 海事物联网中可靠的船舶发动机故障诊断面临分布式数据所有权、异构故障分布以及持续变化的运行条件等挑战。本文提出了SeaCausal-FL，这是一种联邦模糊因果学习框架，它将共享的时间诊断路径与基于机制的因果推理相结合。该框架采用区间二型模糊层来表示不确定且相互重叠的运行机制，同时每个机制都与一个物理约束的结构因果模型相关联。在聚合之前，利用运行上下文、因果结构和条件干预-响应特征对本地学习的机制进行对齐。随后，模型参数根据样本、类别、机制以及机制-类别证据进行聚合，而不仅仅依据客户端样本量。学习到的结构方程还进一步通过溯因、行动和预测支持区间反事实推理。
tldr: 提出SeaCausal-FL联邦模糊因果学习框架，通过区间二型模糊层与物理约束结构因果模型对齐分布式机制，并采用多维度证据加权聚合，实现了海事物联网中船舶发动机的可靠故障诊断与区间反事实推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes SeaCausal-FL, a federated fuzzy causal learning framework that aligns locally learned mechanisms via interval type-2 fuzzy layers and physics-constrained structural causal models with multi-dimensional evidence-based aggregation, enabling reliable marine-engine fault diagnosis and interval counterfactual reasoning in maritime IoT.
